targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT CASE ${agg:sqlstring}
           WHEN '5min' THEN to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch FROM m.ingest_ts) / 300) * 300)
           ELSE date_trunc(CASE ${agg:sqlstring}
                  WHEN 'hour' THEN 'hour'
                  WHEN 'day' THEN 'day'
                  WHEN 'month' THEN 'month'
                  ELSE 'hour' END, m.ingest_ts)
         END AS bucket_ts,
         m.ingest_ts,
         m.value_num
  FROM admin_api.v_point_metric_effective m
  WHERE m.plant_id = ${plant_id:sqlstring}
    AND m.metric = ${metric:sqlstring}
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM metric_dict md
      WHERE md.metric = m.metric
        AND md.visible IS TRUE
    )
    AND m.point_id = ${inlet_point_id:sqlstring}
), ohlc AS (
  SELECT bucket_ts,
         CASE ${agg:sqlstring}
           WHEN '5min' THEN bucket_ts + interval '5 minutes'
           WHEN 'hour' THEN bucket_ts + interval '1 hour'
           WHEN 'day' THEN bucket_ts + interval '1 day'
           WHEN 'month' THEN bucket_ts + interval '1 month'
           ELSE bucket_ts + interval '1 hour'
         END AS bucket_end,
         (array_agg(value_num ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC))[1] AS open,
         max(value_num) AS high,
         min(value_num) AS low,
         (array_agg(value_num ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC))[1] AS close
  FROM base
  GROUP BY bucket_ts
)
SELECT (bucket_ts + ((bucket_end - bucket_ts) / 2.0)) AS "time",
       COALESCE(open, close) AS open,
       high,
       low,
       close
FROM ohlc
ORDER BY "time";

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT min(m.ingest_ts) AS from_ts,
         max(m.ingest_ts) AS to_ts
  FROM admin_api.v_point_metric_effective m
  WHERE m.plant_id = ${plant_id:sqlstring}
    AND m.metric = ${metric:sqlstring}
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM metric_dict md
      WHERE md.metric = m.metric
        AND md.visible IS TRUE
    )
    AND m.point_id = ${inlet_point_id:sqlstring}
), alarm AS (
  SELECT md.alarm_low::double precision AS alarm_low,
         md.alarm_high::double precision AS alarm_high
  FROM metric_dict md
  WHERE md.metric = ${metric:sqlstring}
    AND md.visible IS TRUE
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT bounds.from_ts AS "time",
       alarm.alarm_low AS "告警下限线",
       alarm.alarm_high AS "告警上限线"
FROM bounds
JOIN alarm ON true
WHERE bounds.from_ts IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT bounds.to_ts AS "time",
       alarm.alarm_low AS "告警下限线",
       alarm.alarm_high AS "告警上限线"
FROM bounds
JOIN alarm ON true
WHERE bounds.to_ts IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: 出口蜡烛图（${metric:text}｜告警下限:${metric_alarm_low:text} 上限:${metric_alarm_high:text}）

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT m.ingest_ts,
         m.point_id,
         m.value_num,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY m.point_id ORDER BY m.ingest_ts) AS rn,
         count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.point_id) AS total_rows
  FROM admin_api.v_point_metric_effective m
  WHERE m.plant_id = ${plant_id:sqlstring}
    AND m.metric = ${metric:sqlstring}
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM metric_dict md
      WHERE md.metric = m.metric
        AND md.visible IS TRUE
    )
    AND m.point_id IN (${inlet_point_id:sqlstring}, ${outlet_point_id:sqlstring})
), sampled AS (
  SELECT ingest_ts AS "time", point_id, value_num AS value
  FROM base
  WHERE total_rows <= 2000
     OR rn = 1
     OR rn = total_rows
     OR (rn % GREATEST(1::bigint, ceil(total_rows / 1000.0)::bigint)) = 0
)
SELECT s."time",
       CASE WHEN s.point_id = ${inlet_point_id:sqlstring} THEN '入口' ELSE '出口' END AS metric,
       s.value
FROM sampled s
ORDER BY s."time";

panels.title: 时间范围导航（全量：拖拽缩小 / 双击恢复）

options.content: 操作：右侧导航图**拖拽=缩小**，**双击图表=恢复到当前窗口**；蜡烛图上方可快捷切换指标与周期。注意：实时卡片按设备上报周期判断新鲜度，超过 **2 × report_interval_sec** 未收到新数据将显示 **No data**。

list.definition:
WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT v.metric
  FROM admin_api.v_point_metric_effective v
  WHERE v.plant_id = ${plant_id:sqlstring}
    AND v.point_id IN (${inlet_point_id:sqlstring}, ${outlet_point_id:sqlstring})
), named AS (
  SELECT m.metric,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(md.display_name), ''), m.metric) AS metric_text
  FROM metrics m
  LEFT JOIN metric_dict md ON md.metric = m.metric
)
SELECT metric AS __value,
       metric_text AS __text
FROM named
ORDER BY metric;

list.definition:
WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT v.metric
  FROM admin_api.v_point_metric_effective v
  WHERE v.plant_id = ${plant_id:sqlstring}
    AND v.point_id IN (${inlet_point_id:sqlstring}, ${outlet_point_id:sqlstring})
), named AS (
  SELECT m.metric,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(md.display_name), ''), m.metric) AS metric_text,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(md.display_name), ''), m.metric)) AS text_dup_count
  FROM metrics m
  LEFT JOIN metric_dict md ON md.metric = m.metric
)
SELECT metric AS __value,
       CASE
         WHEN text_dup_count > 1 THEN metric_text || ' [' || metric || ']'
         ELSE metric_text
       END AS __text
FROM named
ORDER BY metric
LIMIT 5 OFFSET (((${mean_page:sqlstring})::int - 1) * 5);
